'''al'Akir Mandragoran''' was the last crowned king of the nation of [[Malkier]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Akir Mandragoran}}

== History ==
[[Jain Farstrider]] captured [[Cowin Gemallan]] and brought him back to al'Akir. Due to his betrayal and him being a [[Darkfriend]], al'Akir challenged and then killed Cowin in single combat. He and his wife, [[el'Leanna Mandragoran]], sent [[al'Lan Mandragoran]], their son, out of dying Malkier when he was born. They both were killed at [[Herot's Crossing]] soon afterward.
